title: Galehigh Terraces - Lanterns on the Wind
_note: Option B mood sibling. gbc 4-voice band. The cliff-TOWN reading: cosier, warm D major with a wistful B-minor turn, the wind a background sigh. Vesper motif stated nearly straight and tender at walking pace (A4->D5->E5 hopeful leap, F#5->E5->D5 settle), the B-minor turn colouring the settle home. Distant noise swell once per phrase, never gusty. 20-bar loop; last bar lands on A (dominant) leaning back into the bar-1 lift.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: rounder, lyrical, longer held notes leaning into the breeze. Vesper spine tender.
